prose: Tonight we continue sailing the unexplored waters of the Oera Linda Book, an apparently ancient codex detailing a very different history of civilization and language than the mainstream. Dylan Saccoccio returns to share his examinations of the text. Last time, we talked about the linguistics and philosophy in the OLB, and in this show, we'll look more into the historical narrative it describes.
